cells.gaps: No source found since November 2023 says a court case management system is in service in any court. The 2022 annual report on decisions uploaded to the Judiciary website is outside the window.
cells.note: Treasury funds an electronic case management system being developed for all court levels, the Judiciary still working by hand in January 2025 (ZMB-001), so stage 2. The 2022 report of a stalled system and decisions online (ZMB-002, ZMB-003) is outside the window.
